entries.snippet: A federal judge has once again ordered the White House to restore access for three news organizations President Trump banned last month over their coverage of his administration. The judge ordered full access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico while their legal challenge moves forward.

entries.snippet: The Trump administration's crackdown on immigration may be novel in its tools, methods and scope, but it belongs to a long tradition in this nation's past. Judy Woodruff reports for her series, Crossroads: America at 250.

entries.snippet: Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook's lawyers say that a committee set up by the White House last week to investigate an accusation against her is "demonstrably biased," though they did not close the door on the possibility that she would appear before the panel.

entries.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Saudi oil company Aramco's headquarters, officials say
entries.snippet: Iran-backed Houthi rebels hit the headquarters of the Saudi state-owned oil company Aramco in an overnight strike, two regional officials said Wednesday, damaging the offices of the firm's chief executive and other top officials.

entries.title: WATCH: Nebraska voters hear from Harding, Powell in midterm House debate
entries.snippet: Voters in Nebraska will hear from the two major party candidates seeking to replace retiring Rep. Don Bacon during a debate Wednesday.

entries.title: A gang rape allegation at Cornell highlights how Title IX guides campus sex assault cases
entries.snippet: Cornell University's handling of an alleged fraternity house gang rape is raising questions about how a decades-old federal civil rights law shapes colleges' treatment of campus sexual assault.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Candidates in race to replace Iowa Rep. Feenstra meet for debate
entries.snippet: Republican candidate Chris McGowan and Democratic candidate Dave Dawson will meet face-to-face for a debate Wednesday as they seek the U.S. House seat in Iowa's 4th Congressional District.

entries.title: Cornell president admits he never followed up on gang rape allegation ahead of no-confidence debate
entries.snippet: Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff knew in 2024 that a student had reported being gang raped at a fraternity house, but never followed up to learn what had happened to her or whether any of the accused students had been punished.

entries.title: How proposed cuts to this major national health survey could disadvantage Americans with disabilities
entries.snippet: As many as a quarter of wheelchair users and more than a third of people who are blind or deaf could be miscategorized as not disabled because of the shorter survey, according to some advocates and researchers.

entries.title: Justice Department threatens California with legal action over claim of noncitizens on voter rolls
entries.snippet: The U.S. Department of Justice has threatened California with possible legal action over what it says are noncitizens believed to have received mail ballots for next month's midterm elections.

entries.title: ICE officer appeared to intentionally hit a man with a vehicle in Houston, Texas prosecutor says
entries.snippet: The encounter has set off new criticism over immigration enforcement in Houston, where local prosecutors are also investigating a July fatal shooting by a federal immigration officer.

entries.title: IMF chief urges wealthy nations to rein in debt to ease global economic pressure
entries.snippet: The U.S. and other wealthy nations need to urgently tackle mounting global debt levels that are weighing most heavily on low-income countries and straining the global financial system, the head of the International Monetary Fund said Wednesday.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian refineries as Zelenskyy says 'we're done'
entries.snippet: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced that Ukraine is resuming attacks on Russian energy sites. It came after Moscow summarily ignored a claim by US President Donald Trump that an "energy ceasefire" had been agreed.

entries.title: Romania: 2 ships on fire in Black Sea, 7 crew missing
entries.snippet: Two chemical tankers have caught fire in Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea. The blazes occurred after Russian drones were sighted in Romanian airspace.

entries.title: Hamburg court sentences Iranian agents over plans to attack Jewish leaders in Germany
entries.snippet: Two men acting on behalf of Iran's spy agency have been sentenced to prison in Hamburg for planning to attack German-Jewish leaders.

entries.title: Thousands of German gamblers could sue for their money back
entries.snippet: German gamblers may finally be able to beat the house, thanks to new court rulings in the EU and a federal court. The decisions could help gambling addicts — but the legal road might be difficult.

entries.title: School roof collapse in Pakistan's Peshawar kills dozens of students and one teacher
entries.snippet: Local authorities said more than 50 other people were injured in the disaster. Roof collapses have become increasingly common in Pakistan.

entries.title: Germany news: Train station alcohol ban comes into force
entries.snippet: Consuming alcohol is no longer permitted at train stations in Germany, to improve the lot of travelers and staff alike. Coalition talks are restarting in Berlin, and an inmate is loose in Essen. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Brazil's elections matter for the planet. This is why
entries.snippet: Brazil is heading back to the polls, but the impact could be felt worldwide. With the Amazon vital to the health of the planet, the election could help shape its future.

entries.title: India news: Supreme Court hears Rahul Gandhi's Election Commission plea
entries.snippet: A petition filed by opposition leader Rahul Gandhi and others seeks an independent audit of India's sweeping voter deletions. Meanwhile, actor Imran Khan has reportedly been ordered to leave India. DW has more.

entries.title: Why Chinese tech brands are outpacing Western rivals from EVs to robot vacuums
entries.snippet: From action cameras and smartphones to EVs and robot vacuums, Chinese brands are gaining ground worldwide despite privacy and security concerns. What's driving their rise, and can European rivals keep up?

entries.title: Manchester City, the UAE and the UK's OM in a political tangle
entries.snippet: Nearly 20 years after arriving in England, Manchester City's UAE owners could exit amid cheating charges. That would pose a challenge for a city — and prime minister — closely tied to Abu Dhabi.

entries.title: North Korea, China open border bridge after 12-year delay
entries.snippet: Twelve years after it was constructed, the New Yalu River Bridge between China and North Korea is finally operational. It is the latest sign of warming ties between the two nations.

entries.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
entries.snippet: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

entries.title: India urges Russia, Ukraine to protect Black Sea shipping
entries.snippet: New Delhi wants Moscow and Kyiv to ensure safe commercial shipping in the Black Sea amid attacks that put Indian seafarers at risk.

entries.title: Brazil to shorten workweek in win for Lula ahead of runoff
entries.snippet: Brazil's Senate approved cutting the workweek from 44 to 40 hours. The move could give President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva an edge over his opponent, Flavio Bolsonaro, ahead of the October 25 runoff.

entries.title: North Korea says it tested cruise missiles to be launched from sub
entries.snippet: North Korean state media said the military test-fired cruise missiles designed to be launched from submarines. Pyongyang has ramped up weapons launches in recent weeks.

entries.title: Ukraine says Musk's SpaceX limits Kyiv's Starlink access
entries.snippet: Ukraine accused SpaceX of restricting use of its Starlink system, impacting Kyiv's ability to control its drones as Russian attacks continue unabated. President Zelenskyy has asked Elon Musk to "switch" it back on.

entries.title: Nord Stream trial opens in Germany, defense seeks dismissal
entries.snippet: Serhii Kuznietsov is accused of attacking civilian infrastructure in the 2022 sabotage of the Russian gas pipeline to Germany. His lawyers called Nord Stream a military target, and said their client is sworn to secrecy.

entries.title: How Trump's diesel deal with Russia will impact the United States and Ukraine
entries.snippet: US President Trump's diesel deal with Russia has alarmed Ukraine and its allies. What is he hoping to achieve at home, and what does the deal mean for Kyiv and Moscow?

entries.title: Japanese journalist arrest in Russia's Far East draws rebuke from Tokyo in latest diplomatic spat with Moscow
entries.snippet: A journalist for a Japanese newspaper was arrested on suspicion of spying in Russia's Far East. A geopolitical rivalry over disputed islands in the region has recently caused tension.
